hints.text: Hint: every line of an Add File body must start with "+", including blank lines and code. To create a new file, prefer the write tool.

Hint: grep uses ripgrep's Rust regex: no look-ahead or look-behind; escape literal ( ) { } [ ] with a backslash. For plain text, set literal: true if the tool offers it; to exclude matches, run a second, narrower search.
Hint: in zsh, status is a read-only special variable. Use another name, such as rc.
Hint: offset is a single line number, not a range. Use offset=<first line> and limit=<line count>, e.g. offset: 280, limit: 51 for lines 280-330.

Hint: .memory/project and other .memory levels are symlinks into a separate memory store, not files to stage in this project. Do not stage or force-add .memory paths; save changes with that store's own tooling instead.

Hint: BSD head on macOS rejects a zero or negative count (no GNU-style -n -N). Guard a computed count and skip head when it is not positive. To see the first lines of a file, use the read tool with limit instead of head.
